description: The Mayhem app's window (mayhem.rs, its own EXE): reads the ARAM Mayhem champion select of the League client on this PC with the champion cards it deals (its password stays in Rust) and writes into the client only on the user's click: the pick of one of the dealt cards (mayhem_pick_champion, only a card the window was told, only while the own pick is open) and the item set "Mayhem: <build>" for that champion (mayhem_item_set; only the app's own earlier set for the champion, marked startedFrom mayhem, is replaced, every other set stays as it was). It also reads the champion's public stats from arammeta.com and mayhemstats.lol (only the champion's number goes out), the signed-in player's own rank and the leaderboard from mayhemstats.lol (read-only, only the player's own identifiers go out), the public records of every category from mayhemstats.lol (read-only, only the choice all time or this season goes out), any listed player's public profile from mayhemstats.lol for the player card (mayhem_player, read-only, only the public id or PUUID of a player the app shows goes out), the augment and champion tier lists with champion details from arammeta.com (one public list, nothing sent) and the item list from Data Dragon, and writes its errors to the local error log. Opens a champion's guide page on aramonly.com in the browser (aram_open_guide, a fixed address). Updates itself on click (update.rs, as blank.): asks GitHub for the latest release of maltekruse23-oss/blank with its English notes, and only on the install click downloads that release's mayhem.exe from GitHub, checks size and GitHub's SHA-256, replaces the running file and restarts; update_news says once after an update that it should show what is new. When an update of blank. installed this app as blank.exe, it cleans up after blank. once on its own (from_blank.rs) and mayhem_moved only returns the one English line of what was removed; the page cannot start, choose or repeat anything of it. The page cannot name another file or address. "Find my Mayhem rank" (mayhem_find_rank, aram/ladder.rs): on click uploads the signed-in player's own ARAM Mayhem games from the client's history (the client's answer per game, only games that name the player and the site does not count yet) to mayhemstats.lol's archive with this installation's random upload key from the Windows Credential Manager, then reads the rank; after each ARAM Mayhem game the same happens by itself only while mayhemstats.lol lists the player. The page names nothing of it. After each ARAM Mayhem game the window gets the player's card (aram/game_card.rs, read-only from the client's end-of-game stats or history, with the players of the game who are League friends or on the public leaderboard, matched on this PC), compared with the same all-time records (mayhem_records), and mayhem_open_game opens that game's page on mayhemstats.lol in the browser (a fixed address with the game's number). The window is frameless: its own bar may drag it, minimize, maximize or restore it (also by double click), ask whether it is maximized and close it (closing quits the app). Nothing else; no other window, filesystem, shell or HTTP permissions.
